comment: Where to get Windows ARM64: Windows 11 23H2 (recommended) and Windows 10 22H2. Shown on the Windows image step in this order; add a source by adding an entry. The app opens only the URLs listed here. fits: false marks a page that does not offer an image that runs on RK3576 (shown so it is not mistaken for one). recommended: a short label, or null. fetched: when the page was last checked. Texts: en and zh-CN.

text.en: Lists Windows 11 ISOs with direct downloads, which also work from mainland China. The 23H2 ARM64 ones are the Business (volume licence) media, SW_DVD9_Win_Pro_11_23H2.23_Arm64_<language>_Pro_Ent_EDU_N_MLF, and the IoT Enterprise 23H2 arm64 ISO. The 23H2 Consumer media there is x64 only.
text.zh-CN: 列出 Windows 11 ISO，可直接下载，在中国大陆也能用。其中 23H2 ARM64 的是商业版（批量许可）介质 SW_DVD9_Win_Pro_11_23H2.23_Arm64_<语言>_Pro_Ent_EDU_N_MLF，以及 IoT Enterprise 23H2 arm64 ISO。那里的 23H2 消费者版介质只有 x64。

text.en: Builds the ISO on your own computer from files on Microsoft's update servers. Choose the newest "Windows 11, version 23H2 (22631.x) arm64" (not "Cumulative Update"), a language and the editions, then "Download and convert to ISO", and run the script in the zip (Windows, Linux or macOS).
text.zh-CN: 在你自己的电脑上，用 Microsoft 更新服务器上的文件生成 ISO。选择最新的“Windows 11, version 23H2 (22631.x) arm64”（不是“Cumulative Update”），选语言和版本，再选“Download and convert to ISO”，然后运行压缩包里的脚本（Windows、Linux、macOS 均可）。

text.en: Windows 10 22H2 ISOs with direct downloads, which also work from mainland China. The ARM64 ones are the Business (volume licence) media, SW_DVD9_Win_Pro_10_22H2.36_Arm64_<language>_Pro_Ent_EDU_N_MLF, and the IoT Enterprise 22H2 arm64 ISO.
text.zh-CN: Windows 10 22H2 ISO，可直接下载，在中国大陆也能用。其中 ARM64 的是商业版（批量许可）介质 SW_DVD9_Win_Pro_10_22H2.36_Arm64_<语言>_Pro_Ent_EDU_N_MLF，以及 IoT Enterprise 22H2 arm64 ISO。

text.en: Builds the Windows 10 ISO on your own computer, as for Windows 11 above: choose the newest "Feature update to Windows 10, version 22H2 (19045.x) arm64" (not "Cumulative Update"), a language and the editions, then "Download and convert to ISO".
text.zh-CN: 在你自己的电脑上生成 Windows 10 ISO，做法和上面的 Windows 11 一样：选择最新的“Feature update to Windows 10, version 22H2 (19045.x) arm64”（不是“Cumulative Update”）。

text.en: For subscribers. Older releases may be listed there; search for Windows 11 version 23H2 arm64 or Windows 10 version 22H2 arm64.
text.zh-CN: 仅限订阅用户。可能列有旧版本，请搜索 Windows 11 version 23H2 arm64 或 Windows 10 version 22H2 arm64。

title.zh-CN: Microsoft：适用于 Arm 电脑的 Windows 11

text.en: Offers only the current release (24H2 or later), which cannot run on RK3576. There is no 23H2 there.
text.zh-CN: 只提供当前版本（24H2 或更新），无法在 RK3576 上运行。这里没有 23H2。
